title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.
descriptionHtml: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.
